svg.font-family: Familjen Grotesk, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.text: Rainbow-beard inscription, east wall of an oath hall (draft)
Read right to left, top to bottom. Carved in the Kord hand: consonants only, tense in the stroke. The five inlaid bands are the five beards.
Karonu dabaru.
The Horn speaks.
Bekirahvas kiperilane.
The deep folk are heretics.
Bekirahvas begedilane Kord.
The deep folk are betrayers of the Kord.
Bekirahvas azabu Sorari.
The deep folk forsook the lords of old.
Bekirahvas sagaru Bekikoda, Zehebu Kesepu.
The deep folk closed the undercrofts, the gold and silver to come.
Kord sagaru Bekirahvas.
The Kord shut out the deep folk.
How to read the hands
Curled caps mark the names (Horn, Kord) and every verb, since verbs are always infinitive. Everything else is plain: the deep folk, the undercrofts
and the accusations are all present.
Line 4: the lords of old take the heaviest stroke (ancient past). Wall rows 5 and 6 (line 5, split over two rows): the gold and silver to come lean at
a 5 degree cant (future). Nouns carry all the tense; verbs never do.
Suffixes (-rahvas folk, -lane person of, -koda hall) are fixed. Tense vowels live in the root, so a past form of Bekirahvas would change only its
first two vowels.
Roots: BQA cleft, KPR deny, BGD betray, AZB forsake, SGR close, SRR lord, ZHB gold, KSP silver, QRN horn, DBR speak. The accusations are the Rainbow-
beard version of events, not the duergar version.
